thread:
joyce: quick sync — we need to lock span naming + required semantic attrs for LLM requests before the telemetry exporter change next week. open to bikeshedding but want something we can commit to in code and dashboards.
ben: +1. leaning toward a compact span.name and rich attributes. e.g., name = \"llm.request\" and attrs contain operation/model/tokens/cache/routing
alina: don't bury operation in an attribute only. operation (generate/embed/rerank) should be queryable as a top-level attr, but span.name can be generic.
tim: agree. breaking down by operation in span.name makes dashboards noisy. keep span.name stable so traces group well.
ben: proposal sketch:

```
span.name = "llm.request"
attributes:
  llm.operation = "generate" | "embed" | "rank"
  llm.model.name = "gpt-neox-20b"
  llm.model.variant = "q4_0"
  llm.model.size = "20b"
  llm.tokens.prompt = 128
  llm.tokens.generated = 64
  llm.kv_cache.hit = true
  llm.kv_cache.hits = 3
  routing.policy = "latency-first" | "cost-first"
  quota.bucket = "free-tier" | "enterprise-committed"
  batch.id = "abc123"  // optional
```
alina: +1 but prefer `llm.cache.hit` over kv_cache to avoid leaking internal impl details. also suggest boolean `llm.cache.partial_hit` for prefix-only cache matches.
joyce: good point. we should standardize naming prefix `llm.*` and avoid provider-specific terms. also add `llm.model.family` for groupings (e.g., \"mistral\", \"redwood-rl\").
tim: sampling rules: keep all error spans, sample 1% of successful requests by default but make sampling key include model.name and operation. exports: OTLP to observability pipeline, and routing separate ingest for billing metrics.
ben: retention: traces 7d default, but we should allow per-customer retention overrides in Dedicated/Private. also export aggregated per-model usage metrics to metrics backend with 90d retention.
alina: console UX note — allow quick filter pill `model:gpt-*` and `cache:hit` in the traces view. dashboards should show p50/p95 latency by operation + tokens generated buckets.
joyce: edge cases: streaming responses — we should record span.duration as full stream time and add attribute `llm.streamed=true` and `llm.stream.bytes` optional. also add `llm.completed = true|false` for early cancellations.
ben: security/PII: ensure no prompt text in attributes. only token counts. if teams need prompt debugging, route to secure audit logs with access control.
alina: implement a short span-attribute contract PR with these keys + types and examples. I'll draft a table for the SDKs.
joyce: decision for now (consensus):
- span.name = "llm.request"
- required attrs: llm.operation, llm.model.name, llm.model.family, llm.tokens.prompt, llm.tokens.generated, llm.cache.hit, routing.policy
- optional attrs: llm.model.variant, llm.model.size, llm.kv_cache.hits (deprecated in favor of llm.cache.hits), batch.id, llm.streamed, llm.completed
- sampling: keep errors, sample successes 1% by default; sample keys include llm.model.name + llm.operation
- exporters: OTLP to telemetry pipeline; separate aggregated metrics export to metrics backend for billing/retention
- retention: traces 7d default; metrics 90d; per-customer overrides for Dedicated/Private

joyce: @tim can you add the sampling hook and config flags in the runtime config? @alina can you open the PR for the attribute contract? I'll update the console filter UX ticket.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-exporter v2 -> staging at 06:30 UTC. monitoring alerts enabled for exporter-latency > 5s :warning:

tim: will do the sampling config this afternoon.
alina: PR created: https://git.redwood.infra/p/telemetry/+/234 — includes table + example span JSON
joyce: perfect, thanks. we'll iterate if anything breaks during staging. :thumbsup:
